extracted.stage: Children and finance matter with a hearing listed at the Family Court at Leeds
extracted.summary: A solicitor asks whether a £4,000 loan for a single counsel's fee in a Leeds children and finance matter, with about £167,000 of assets in dispute, meets the minimum loan size.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry, which we have received and logged. To consider it further we will need confirmation of the client's details, the nature and current stage of the proceedings, and the basis on which the £167,000 of assets in dispute is valued. It would also help to have details of the hearing listed for 30 December, the counsel's fee note or costs estimate, and confirmation of your firm's involvement. We cannot comment at this stage on whether funding is available or on any terms. A member of the team will be in touch once the information above has been reviewed.
